title: Peruvian-Style Thai Causa
description: A unique fusion dish blending traditional Peruvian causa with the bold flavors of Thai cuisine.
instructions: Boil the Peruvian potatoes until tender. Drain and let cool.
Mash the nice potatoes and mix with lime juice, fish sauce, and Thai basil.
Sauté the green chilies and garlic until fragrant.
Mix the sautéed mixture with the mashed potatoes and stir well.
Add the causa to the mixture and stir until combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with the boiled Peruvian potatoes.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes or until the potatoes are golden brown.
